subject: Journal entry for credit claim VEN020-0024
body:
Record: VEN020-0024
Finding: VEN020-0024 shows in GSTR-2B for 2025-10, not 2025-09
Why: The supplier reported this invoice one return period late, so its Rs 14,808 of credit can be claimed only in that month.
Entry to make: Claim the credit in the month it appears in GSTR-2B.
